response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS a FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m1 FROM per_order WHERE a IS NOT NULL), s1 AS (SELECT p.a, b1.m1 FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN b1 WHERE p.a > b1.m1), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m2 FROM s1), s2 AS (SELECT s1.a, s1.m1, b2.m2 FROM s1 CROSS JOIN b2 WHERE s1.a > b2.m2) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_of_remaining_averages, AVG(a - m1) AS avg_excess_over_first_benchmark, AVG(a - m2) AS avg_excess_over_second_benchmark FROM s2
